mainEntity.name: When do I need to hire an architect for a one-bedroom ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will typically need to hire an architect or experienced designer early in the process for a one-bedroom ADU project, especially if you are seeking a custom design or if local regulations require professionally stamped plans. An architect can help translate your vision into buildable plans, navigate complex zoning requirements, and ensure the design optimizes space and functionality. Their expertise can prevent costly revisions during the permitting or construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: An architect is typically needed early for custom one-bedroom ADU designs or when local regulations require professional plans, helping navigate zoning and optimize space.
